Name: Kanye West - Donda [Cover]
Notes: Donda is Kanye West’s tenth studio album, released on August 29, 2021. The record is named after Kanye’s late mother, Donda West. After a 15-month wait, the album finally ended up releasing almost two days after the final listening party, on the early morning of August 29, 2021, with the addition of four new remixes of songs on the album.

Name: The Melodic Blue [Cover](feat. Don Toliver, Kendrick Lamar, &Travis Scott)
Notes: The Melodic Blue is Baby Keem’s debut studio album. The project has been in the works since late 2019 and was announced to be “on the way” via Instagram in early August 2020. The project would not be released for another 13 months. Following the release of the singles leading up to the album Keem began indicating that a release was imminent. Two days after featuring on Kanye Wests tenth studio album Donda Keem announced that he had turned the album in, and, on September 2, he stated that it would be arriving that month. The Melodic Blue was released on September 10, 2021, and would get a "DLC" on September 22, that added Brent Faiyaz to the track "lost souls". Two months after releasing his debut album, Keem earned himself four Grammy nominations.

Name: Don Toliver - Life of a Don  [Cover]
Notes: Life of a DON is Don Toliver’s second studio album and third official project, following the success of his 2020 debut album, Heaven Or Hell. The album name was officially announced on Don Toliver’s Instagram on September 28, 2021. Don Toliver released the first official single “What You Need” on May 4, 2021, which charted at #82 for a week on the Billboard Hot 100. On June 18, 2021, he dropped the second single “Drugs N Hella Melodies,” featuring Colombian-American singer Kali Uchis.

(2017), his first album release under his creative collective PGLang, and his final project with TDE (under which he released four albums and was one of their flagship artists).
